title: Simultaneous compositional arithmetic over shared engram codes
hypothesis: Signed/sparse superposition of compact Mirror memory codes preserves multi-memory retrieval, composition and erasure with at least 25% fewer bytes than independent traces and beats native addition/factorization.

development.tuning: none; closed-form PCA and residual ranks 0/1/3

fresh.release_rule: Keep sealed after native alias or quality/byte miss.

success_gate: Composition, retrieval and cancellation nRMSE <=0.02; erasure removes only target; >=25% fewer bytes than independent; strict Mirror advantage over native controls.
failure_gate: FAIL if any functional/byte gate misses or native addition/factorization matches Mirror without compute advantage.
boundaries: Synthetic vectors only; not AI Engram or cognitive evidence.
Only 256 mixtures tested; combination counts are not capacity.
Three private exceptions are constructed and fully charged.
Fresh seeds remain sealed after alias or gate miss.
